statement.zh: 比斯马亚（阿达布）芝加哥大学 1903–1905 年田野与器物材料（含神庙相关铭文，组合级）见 Wilson OIP 138（2012）。
statement.en: At Bismaya (Adab), University of Chicago 1903–1905 field and object materials (including temple-related inscriptions at assemblage level) are documented in Wilson OIP 138 (2012).
